description: Consolidated ABA PayWay error/status code registry. sandboxVerified: true means the meaning was reproduced against the live sandbox; evidence points into docs/SANDBOX-FINDINGS. observedOn/observedMessage carry ABA production telemetry (dev-team CSV, 2026-09-15): the gateway APIs where the code was seen and the exact gateway message; API labels map to paths in docs/12 (errors-and-debugging topic). Regenerate with `npm run gen:error-registry`.

codes.title: ABA account payment OK
codes.hint: Payer-account success — treat like 00 (purchase telemetry: tens of thousands of occurrences).
codes.observedMessage: OK

codes.title: ABA account payment declined — transient
codes.hint: Payer-account decline, usually transient — the customer-facing message advises retrying in a few minutes; safe to surface as-is.
codes.observedMessage: Sorry, we couldn't process the payment. Please try again in few minutes or contact to the merchant directly.

codes.title: ABA account insufficient funds
codes.hint: The payer ABA account lacks funds — customer tops up or pays from another account.
codes.observedMessage: Payer account has insufficient funds.

codes.title: Invalid hash
codes.hint: Wrong HMAC composition — check the field order for the CoF endpoint being called.

codes.title: Invalid hash
codes.hint: Wrong HMAC composition — check the field order for the CoF endpoint being called.

codes.title: Validation / binding failure
codes.hint: Laravel-style binding/validation layer rejected the request — inspect the errors{} field map on the thrown error.
codes.observedMessage: The given data was invalid.

codes.title: Token not found
codes.hint: The ctid/request_id does not reference a known account token — verify or re-link.

codes.title: Merchant ID not found
codes.hint: Merchant ID not found — verify the merchant credential (env/profile) for the target environment.

codes.title: Merchant not enabled for token flag
codes.hint: The merchant account is not enabled for this token_flag — contact PayWay to provision, or use a linking enum (CITI_FLEX|CITO_FLEX|CITO_FIX|CITR_FLEX).

codes.title: Invalid payment credential token
codes.hint: The payment credential token is invalid or expired — re-link via linkAccount/linkCard or renew via renewToken. On purchase/charge the gateway also words it "Invalid pwt or ctid." — for ctid-keyed charges check the ctid→pwt resolution first (production telemetry 2026-09).
codes.observedMessage: Invalid pwt or ctid.

codes.title: Success
codes.hint: Business success. purchase/exchange-rate/close-transaction/transaction-list and the merchant-portal APIs report "00"; generate-qr and payout report "0".

codes.title: Wrong Hash
codes.hint: HMAC signature mismatch — check API key, field ordering, base64 vs hex encoding.
codes.observedMessage: Wrong Hash.

codes.title: Transaction Not Closable
codes.hint: Transaction status does not allow close — sandbox-verified: closing an already PAID transaction answers 403 code 2 (SANDBOX-FINDINGS §21). Only OPEN/PENDING transactions can be closed.

codes.title: Invalid Transaction Amount
codes.hint: Amount rejected (non-positive, wrong decimal scale, or mismatched) — seen on purchase, pre-auth-completion and refund (production telemetry 2026-09).
codes.observedMessage: Invalid Transaction Amount.

codes.title: Duplicated Transaction ID
codes.hint: tran_id already exists for this merchant — send a fresh unique tran_id (production telemetry 2026-09: purchase, generate-qr, payout). The STRING code "04" is the separate validation/binding failure.
codes.observedMessage: Duplicated Transaction ID.

codes.title: Transaction Not Found
codes.hint: Close/cancel target does not exist — verify tran_id.
codes.observedMessage: Transaction not found

codes.title: tran_id not found
codes.hint: check-transaction found no transaction with this ID. On purchase the same numeric code means "Requested Domain is not in whitelist" (production telemetry 2026-09) — ask PayWay to whitelist the domain.

codes.title: Invalid Request Data
codes.hint: Missing or malformed field - check parameter types.

codes.title: merchant_id not found
codes.hint: Merchant identity rejected on this endpoint (sandbox-verified HTTP 403 on check-transaction) - check PAYWAY_MERCHANT_ID or the active profile. Production telemetry 2026-09: on refund/payout/transaction-list/generate-qr an 8 is instead a GENERIC 500-class "Something went wrong" — retry once, then contact PayWay support with the trace id.
codes.observedMessage: Something went wrong. Please reach out to our digital support team for assistance

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Payout currency must match the beneficiary account currency and your merchant credential currency (e.g. send USD to a USD account).
codes.observedMessage: Payment currency is not allowed.

codes.title: Invalid Merchant
codes.hint: merchant_id not recognized in this environment.

codes.title: Invalid Amount
codes.hint: Amount format wrong — use formatAmount()/decimal rules for the currency.

codes.title: Invalid Currency
codes.hint: Currency must be 'USD' or 'KHR'.

codes.title: Expired Transaction
codes.hint: Transaction/token expired — create a new one or renew the token.

codes.title: Transaction Not Found
codes.hint: No transaction with this tran_id (may have been closed).

codes.title: Invalid Beneficiary Data
codes.hint: RSA-encrypted beneficiaries malformed — verify public key + account format.

codes.title: Invalid Merchant Profile
codes.hint: Merchant identity rejected (sandbox-verified HTTP 400 on exchange-rate with unknown merchant_id) — check PAYWAY_MERCHANT_ID or the active profile.
codes.observedMessage: Invalid Merchant Profile

codes.title: Card Inactive
codes.hint: Issuer reports the card inactive — customer uses another card (purchase telemetry 2026-09: "your card is inactive").
codes.observedMessage: Sorry, your payment cannot be processed as your card is inactive. Please use another card.

codes.title: Card Declined By Issuer
codes.hint: Issuer declined — customer verifies the card is active or uses another card.
codes.observedMessage: Your payment is declined by the card issuer bank. Please make sure your card is active, or contact your issuer bank for support.

codes.title: Payout Whitelist
codes.hint: Payout account not whitelisted — call addBeneficiary() first (production message: "Payout accounts are not in whitelist.").
codes.observedMessage: Payout accounts are not in whitelist.

codes.title: Invalid Request
codes.hint: Validation failed. For transaction-list dates use "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss".

codes.title: Incorrect Card Details
codes.hint: Card number/expiry/CVV failed — customer re-enters the card details.
codes.observedMessage: Incorrect card details. Please check and try again.

codes.title: Card Declined By Issuer
codes.hint: Issuer declined without detail — customer contacts the issuer bank or uses another card.
codes.observedMessage: Your payment is declined by the card issuer bank. Please contact issuer bank for support.

codes.title: Card Insufficient Funds
codes.hint: Card funds/limit exhausted — customer uses another card or frees funds first.
codes.observedMessage: Your payment card has insufficient funds. Please check and try again.

codes.title: Card Usage Limit Reached
codes.hint: Card hit its issuer usage limit — another card, or issuer-bank support.
codes.observedMessage: Your payment card has reached its usage limit. Please use another card, or contact issuer bank for support.

codes.title: Card Declined By Issuer
codes.hint: Issuer declined without detail — customer contacts the issuer bank or uses another card.
codes.observedMessage: Your payment is declined by the card issuer bank. Please contact issuer bank for support.

codes.title: Lifetime Below Minimum
codes.hint: Checkout purchase lifetime must be >= 3 minutes (API takes minutes; max 43200 = 30 days; spec-documented).

codes.title: Card Declined By Issuer
codes.hint: Issuer declined; message advises another card or issuer-bank support.
codes.observedMessage: Your payment is declined by the card issuer bank. Please use another card, or contact issuer bank for support.

codes.title: Payee / Merchant Data
codes.hint: Beneficiary payee unknown, or payment-link id invalid (detail).
codes.observedMessage: Invalid merchant data

codes.title: Gateway Error
codes.hint: Generic 500-class failure ("Something went wrong... digital support team") — retry once, then contact PayWay support with the trace id (telemetry: transaction-list, generate-qr, payment-link detail).
codes.observedMessage: Something went wrong. Please reach out to our digital support team for assistance

codes.title: System Under Maintenance
codes.hint: PayWay is under maintenance — pause and retry later (telemetry: purchase).
codes.observedMessage: System under maintenance. We'll update you when available. Thanks for your patience.

codes.title: Something Went Wrong
codes.hint: Generic gateway failure, "please try again later" — retry with backoff; not a merchant config issue (telemetry: purchase).
codes.observedMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

codes.title: Parameter Invalid Format
codes.hint: Check datatypes — amounts are numbers in the SDK (the official docs declare strings; the gateway accepts numbers). Sandbox probes: malformed values answered PTL04 instead.

codes.title: Merchant Invalid Currency
codes.hint: Currency not enabled for the merchant profile. Sandbox probe: EUR answered PTL04 — PTL99 not yet reproduced on this profile.

codes.title: Invalid Payment Link
codes.hint: Invalid payment link — pass the opaque data.id returned by create, NOT merchant_ref_no, NOT the URL slug. Sandbox note (2026-09-06): a bogus id answered 96 instead.

codes.title: Payment Link Already Voided
codes.hint: The payment link is already voided — already in the desired terminal state, not a failure. Void is not idempotent (HTTP 403, SANDBOX-FINDINGS §23); a second void on the same link id always answers PTL188.

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Payout currency must match the beneficiary account currency and your merchant credential currency. Send USD to a USD account; KHR to a KHR account.
codes.observedMessage: Payment currency is not allowed.

codes.title: Payout amount mismatch
codes.hint: Sum of beneficiary amounts must equal the payout (transaction complete) amount.

codes.title: Payout account not whitelisted
codes.hint: Whitelist the beneficiary first via addBeneficiary().

codes.title: Payout account not whitelisted
codes.hint: Whitelist the beneficiary first via addBeneficiary().

codes.title: Payout account not whitelisted
codes.hint: Whitelist the beneficiary first via addBeneficiary().

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Payout currency must match the beneficiary account currency and your merchant credential currency. Send USD to a USD account; KHR to a KHR account.

codes.title: Payee already exists
codes.hint: The payee is already on the payout whitelist — benign, no action needed (production telemetry 2026-09: the most common add-whitelist response). Re-enable via update-whitelist-status if it was disabled.
codes.observedMessage: Payee already exists.

codes.title: Unable to complete pre-auth
codes.hint: Transaction status does not allow capture, OR the completion amount is incorrect (never authorized, already completed/cancelled) — production message checks both.
codes.observedMessage: Unable to complete pre-authorization: The transaction status is invalid or the completion amount is incorrect

codes.title: Merchant information invalid
codes.hint: Sandbox profile lacks permission for this operation (e.g. complete-with-payout) — contact PayWay to provision.

codes.title: Unable to cancel pre-auth
codes.hint: Only OPEN/PENDING pre-auths can be cancelled — check current status first.
codes.observedMessage: Unable to cancel pre-authorization: The transaction status is invalid

codes.title: Pre-auth completion failed (PSP error)
codes.hint: The payment service provider returned an unexpected response during completion — retry once, then contact PayWay support with the trace id (production telemetry 2026-09).
codes.observedMessage: Pre-authorization completion failed: The payment service provider returned an unexpected response

codes.title: QR request rejected (wrong hash or malformed request)
codes.hint: Check the 19-field HMAC order (req_time..payout) and the API key.

codes.title: Requested Domain is not in whitelist
codes.hint: The request origin/return domain is not whitelisted for this merchant profile — ask PayWay to whitelist it (purchase telemetry 2026-09). Legacy gateway gloss: tran_id not found on check-transaction.
codes.observedMessage: Requested Domain is not in whitelist.

codes.title: Payment currency not allowed
codes.hint: Currency not enabled for the merchant profile — use USD/KHR or ask PayWay to enable it (generate-qr + purchase telemetry).
codes.observedMessage: Payment currency is not allowed.

codes.title: Invalid First Name
codes.hint: first_name must not contain numbers/special characters and is capped at 100 chars (purchase field validation — the spec-page gloss "invalid amount" does not match production).
codes.observedMessage: Invalid First Name. It must not contain numbers or special characters or not more than 100 characters.

codes.title: Invalid Last Name
codes.hint: last_name must not contain numbers/special characters and is capped at 100 chars (purchase field validation).
codes.observedMessage: Invalid Last Name. It must not contain numbers or special characters or not more than 100 characters.

codes.title: QR gateway error code 18
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: Invalid Email
codes.hint: The email field is malformed (purchase field validation).
codes.observedMessage: Invalid Email.

codes.title: End of API lifetime
codes.hint: The transaction/QR lifetime elapsed before payment completed — create a fresh transaction (generate-qr telemetry; the spec-page gloss "invalid transaction ID" does not match production).
codes.observedMessage: End of API lifetime.

codes.title: QR gateway error code 23
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: Service is not enabled
codes.hint: The service/feature this call needs is not enabled on the merchant profile (e.g. pushback) — ask PayWay to provision it; sandbox-verified on payment-link create (§22). Gateway message literally reads "Service is not enable."
codes.observedMessage: Service is not enable.

codes.title: QR gateway error code 35
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: Purchase has reached transaction limit
codes.hint: The merchant/profile transaction limit was reached (purchase telemetry; the spec-page gloss "invalid template" does not match production).

codes.title: QR gateway error code 47
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: QR gateway error code 48
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: Invalid merchant data
codes.hint: Merchant data rejected — verify merchant_id/credential for the target environment (generate-qr + add-whitelist-payout telemetry).

codes.title: QR gateway error code 102
codes.hint: Meaning not individually published — consult the generate-qr page on developer.payway.com.kh.

codes.title: Forbidden
codes.hint: Merchant credential not authorized for generate-qr in this environment.

codes.title: Rate limit exceeded
codes.hint: Pace requests — the SDK throttles locally, but concurrent callers share the window.

codes.title: Invalid hash
codes.hint: Check API key and HMAC field ordering.

codes.title: Parameter validation required
codes.hint: Amount must be ≥ $0.01 USD / ≥ 1 KHR; check other required fields.
codes.observedMessage: Parameter validation required

codes.title: Transaction not found
codes.hint: Verify the original tran_id — refunds need a captured transaction.
codes.observedMessage: Transaction not found or is invalid

codes.title: Refund exceeds original amount
codes.hint: Reduce the refund amount to fit the remaining refundable balance.

codes.title: Unable to refund
codes.hint: Production message: "invalid transaction status or an incorrect refund amount" — check BOTH the transaction status (transaction-detail) and that the amount fits paid − already-refunded.
codes.observedMessage: Unable to process refund due to an invalid transaction status or an incorrect refund amount

codes.title: Refund failed
codes.hint: PayWay could not process the refund (PSP returned an unexpected response) — retry once, then contact PayWay support with the trace id.
codes.observedMessage: Refund failed: The payment service provider returned an unexpected response

codes.title: Concurrent request rejected
codes.hint: Another request for this transaction is in flight — retry after it settles. Shared by refund AND pre-auth completion/cancellation ("Another request is already in progress. Please wait a few seconds and try again.").
codes.observedMessage: Another request is already in progress. Please wait a few seconds and try again.

codes.title: Insufficient merchant balance
codes.hint: Top up the merchant account before retrying.
